'''Meropta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] foreman of a group of workers stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He asked a passerby to defeat the predators in the [[Tularan Marsh]] region so he and his men could get to work.
